 Follow ‘White Lotus’ Star Gets Brutally Honest on Actresses With Plastic Surgery
 Sam Escobar Thu, November 12, 2026 at 8:53 PM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. John Nacion / Getty Images Carrie Coon is doubling down on her stance toward anti-aging procedures.
 The 45-year-old actress, who portrayed Laurie Duffy in Season 3 of The White Lotus , revealed in an interview with Elle that she finds it difficult to empathize with performers who undergo cosmetic procedures.
 "Of course, women should do what they want to do to feel their best, to not be depressed," the Critics' Choice Award winner told the outlet.
 “The Gilded Age” actress attends the Season 4 HBO premiere on October 26, 2026, in New York City. / Theo Wargo / Theo Wargo/Getty Images She continued, "However, it is worth questioning what we have internalized and where that choice is coming from."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "My experience, as I've watched this augmentation take over my industry—and then everything else, because my industry leads those conversations—I find it so alienating," she said.
 Coon, photographed at the Los Angeles A frozen face, she pointed out, can result in a less-impactful experience for viewers.
 "When I see an actress who's so far down the road that I do experience their face not moving, I don't have as much empathy for them in their performance," Coon said, adding, "I don't have the mirror neurons."​
 Coon, who has played Bertha Russell on The Gilded Age since 2022, said she prefers to "come to terms" with preparing for her morbid ending, rather than living in fear.​
 Advertisement Advertisement "I guess that means I make a choice personally not to do anything to myself, and maybe that means my career has five more years in it. Oh, well, I'll do something else," she explained.
 The actress has previously spoken about anti-aging procedures.
 A younger Carrie Coon attends the "Authenticity is more evocative than any kind of engineering you might consider doing to your face or your body," she told Glamour in a 2025 interview.
